text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! I had a blast too, being able to 
run at full power!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
“Thinking about how the Classics are over 
now, though, does make me feel a little 
bittersweet.”

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
“...Or, maybe I shouldn't be saying that! 
Next year is finally the Senior Class, 
after all!”

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now then, time to change... but before 
that, I'll grab my stuff from the waiting 
room!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Trainer, wait for me~!

I was told to wait, but even after waiting 
for a while, they still hadn't arrived, so 
I went to check on them—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: *sniff*... Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
She was my idol, after all... a "Triple 
Crown Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Because I've been running all this time 
wanting to be cool and become an 
incredible Umamusume like Prez.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yet the sudden realization that I can no 
longer become a Triple Crown Umamusume 
just welled up inside me...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yes! No more being gloomy!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't become a "Triple Crown 
Umamusume," but I've grown so, so much 
during the Classic period!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I've grown in my running, and in all sorts 
of other ways too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that I'm fully prepared to make my 
mark in the Senior Year makes me want to 
run right this second!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
My goal isn't just to be a "Triple Crown 
Umamusume."

Tokai Teio truly is a gifted Umamusume. 
Both in raw ability and spirit...!
choice_data_list:
I'm gonna become the greatest Umamusume 
ever!
Let's become the greatest Umamusume ever!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll shine even brighter from now 
on!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, what stage are we picking for my 
next big performance!?

If she produced results like this in a 
long-distance race like the Kikuka Sho—
choice_data_list:
Let's take on the grand stage—the Tenno 
Sho (Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! A big race right off the bat! I knew 
you'd understand, Trainer~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Charging into the Senior Year, the mighty 
Teio-sama makes her move~! Let's keep 
doing our best together, Trainer!

And so, our first goal for the Senior 
Class was set on the Tenno Sho (Spring).
